entry.title: Testnet5 Launch
entry.summary:
Testnet5 has recently launched, and two public libbitcoin nodes are now actively connected to the network. These nodes are accessible at wormer.libbitcoin.net:18353 and carmine.libbitcoin.net:18353, both running bs with support for bip54. Developers or enthusiasts interested in establishing peer connections can connect directly to these nodes.
To monitor the status of these public nodes, detailed information is available at [https://libbitcoin.org/configuration/public.html](https://libbitcoin.org/configuration/public.html). This resource provides current configuration and connectivity data relevant to anyone participating in or monitoring the testnet5 environment.
For users who prefer to explore the capabilities of the new testnet5 network via a web interface, explorers are deployed and can be accessed at [https://wormer.libbitcoin.net:58143](https://wormer.libbitcoin.net:58143) and [https://carmine.libbitcoin.net:58143](https://carmine.libbitcoin.net:58143). These web explorers facilitate easy navigation and inspection of blockchain data on the testnet.
Comprehensive information about the Libbitcoin project, its features, and ongoing development can be found at [https://libbitcoin.org](https://libbitcoin.org). This site serves as the primary reference point for documentation, node configurations, and further community engagement.
